name: Smoothie
author: PointillViz authors
description: Gene modules that share a spatial pattern, found by the published Smoothie package.
long_description: Runs Smoothie (Holdener & De Vlaminck, Commun Biol 2026) as its authors ship it: it smooths every gene over the tissue with a Gaussian, correlates the smoothed genes, links the pairs above a cutoff and clusters that network into modules. Returns the modules as a table, a figure mapping each one on the tissue, and every gene's module as a download.
citation: Holdener C, De Vlaminck I. Smoothie: efficient inference and integration of spatial co-expression networks from denoised spatial transcriptomics data. Commun Biol 9, 459 (2026). https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-026-09898-z

params.name: smoothing_width
params.label: Smoothing width (microns)
params.help:
Sets the width of the Gaussian that smooths each gene over the tissue, its standard deviation.
The authors find 20 to 40 µm works best. Wider finds broader patterns; sparse tissue needs it wider.

params.name: correlation_cutoff
params.label: Correlation cutoff
params.help:
Links two genes when their smoothed maps correlate above this.
Higher keeps fewer genes, in tighter modules. Lower takes longer. The summary gives the authors' lower bound for this run.

params.name: clustering_power
params.label: Clustering power
params.help:
Sets how strongly weak links are discounted when the network is clustered.
Higher gives more, smaller modules. The authors find 1 to 6 reasonable.
